In the same way that EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR sends recent students / graduates to do traineeships at workplaces abroad, it will also promote the invitation of personnel from those companies / contractors to teach at the Institution, and thus bring the reality of work closer to students who do not carry out mobility and start projects of mutual interest.

For EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR, staff training mobility will be part of the Institution's human resources / professional development policy. Likewise, it will pay special attention to cooperation projects for innovation and the exchange of projects of good practices, taking as a reference the REALISE project (Realising the potential of international mobility of staff in higher education).

**-EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR will actively support incoming mobile participants throughout the accommodation search process.**

EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR as receiving organization will clearly explain to the participants in the mobility what accommodation options are open and what are the conditions for renting the accommodation (for example, costs, registration details and accommodation contract, responsibilities), in order to minimize any problems upon arrival. This will be done at least two months in advance of the mobility period and will involve EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR taking stock of the housing situation for mobile students , in order to be aware of any potential obstacles to find accommodation and how to overcome them. It will propose solutions to potential problems participants face by collaborating with housing providers, student organizations, or other stakeholders that offer accommodation, and will work to ensure the quality and affordability of student housing.

EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR will make the availability of information about this aspect on its website, together with the contact details of the consultant for the accommodation of the Institution. This information will include details on student accommodation, frequently asked questions, comments on past student experiences, and details on any possible fraud or discrimination attempts that may be found. If applicable, the contact details of the student organizations will be made available to the students on the Institution´s website, since it is an important source of information.

EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR will offer support and guidance in case students experience fraud or discrimination, to overcome the problem.

EA PEDRO ALMODOVAR as sending institution will also assist mobile participants in their search for accommodation by contacting, when necessary, their counterparts at the receiving IES / company / organization or by contacting former mobile participants who are willing to help find accommodation with future students. The Institution will attend to mobile students especially in this aspect, since they are mostly affected by the problem of access to housing according to the HousErasmus + Study.

In international credit mobility, the student grant may be used to pay the accommodation deposit.
